name: rowo-nexus
description: ROwO Nexus anonymous identity protocol, wallet, and Cloudflare reference architecture.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/browser-e2e/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/concurrency/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tests/worker-integration/tsconfig.json && tsc -p workers/projector/test/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && vitest run tests/protocol tests/security
scripts.test:workers: pnpm --filter @nexus/registry-worker test:worker && pnpm --filter @nexus/projector-worker test && pnpm --filter @nexus/transparency-worker test:workers && pnpm --filter @nexus/reference-rp test:worker && vitest run --config tests/worker-integration/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:workers && pnpm test:vectors && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build && pnpm cf:dry-run
